description: This file defines a Java class 'UpdateLikelihoodCommandHandler' which handles update commands for likelihood entities within a survey infrastructure module. It uses Spring annotations for service declaration, transaction management, and command typing, and interacts with a service to perform the update operation.

classes.name: UpdateLikelihoodCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles update commands for likelihood entities, wired with 'WriteLikelihoodService', and processes commands within transactional context.

methods.name: UpdateLikelihoodCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor to inject the WriteLikelihoodService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the update command by invoking the update method on WriteLikelihoodService with entity ID and command data.
